book.name: 2 TIMOTI
book.title: Di Sekant Leta Weh Paal Rait tu TIMOTI

content: Di soalja weh nohwahn ton bak
Mi son, yu fi mek di grays
weh wi geh bikaaz wi da wan wid Krais Jeezas kip yu schrang.
Di werd dehn weh yu yehr Ah seh fronta lata peepl, yu fi paas aan, ahn tel dehn tu faytful peepl weh wahn kip dehn eena dehn haat ahn wahn teech ada peepl dehn sayhn ting.
Yu fi bayr op anda sofarin wid wee bikaaz yu da wahn chroo soalja a Krais Jeezas.
Wahn soalja wahn waahn pleez di aafisa weh deh oava ahn, soh ih noh wahn geh miks op wid aadineri laif.
Sayhn way soh, di wan weh play spoats wahn kyaahn win di praiz if ih noh di fala di rool dehn.
Di faama weh di werk haad fi mek di krap groa, hihn shuda bee fos fi geh ih paat a di haavis.
Tink oava weh Ah di seh, bikaaz di Laad wahn help yu andastan evriting.
Memba Jeezas Krais weh kohn fahn Dayvid famili lain? Wel, Gaad rayz hihn fahn di ded, ahn dat da di Gud Nyooz weh Ai preech.
Ahn bikaaz Ai di tel peepl di Gud Nyooz, Ah di sofa ya. Dehn eevn chayn mi op laik wahn kriminal. Bot dehn kyaahn chayn di Werd a Gaad.
Bikaaz a dat, Ah di bayr evriting fi sayka di peepl weh Gaad don pik, soh dat dehn tu wahn geh di salvayshan weh kohn fahn Krais Jeezas ahn weh bring gloari weh noh wahn en.
Dis sayin da chroo, ahn ih seh,

content.text: If wi don ded wid Krais,
wi wahn liv wid ahn tu.
wi wahn rool wid ahn tu.
If wi seh wi noh noa ahn,
hihn tu wahn seh hihn noh noa wee.
stilyet hihn wahn bee faytful tu wi,

content: Di werkman wehGaad satisfai wid

Yu fi kip aan di rimain evribadi bowt dehn ting ya. Ahn waan dehn fronta di Laad dat dehn noh fi aagyu bowt dehn werdz weh noh meen notn. Dat noh help nobadi, ahn ih jos dischrai di peepl weh di yehr it.
Du aal yu kud fi mek Gaad satisfai wid yu, az wahn werkman weh noh ga notn fi bee shaym fa, ahn weh di teech peepl di chroo Werd a Gaad, eena di rait way, jos laik yu shuda teech it.
Stay weh fahn foolish taak weh noh ga notn fi du wid Gaad, bikaaz dat jos wahn mek peepl stap fala Gaad moa ahn moa.
Dehndeh kaina teechin da laik wahn soar weh noh waahn geh beta. Himinayos ahn Fileetos di taak da kaina way.
Dehn don ton weh fahn di way a di chroot, ahn dehn di seh dat di taim don paas wen peepl weh don ded wahn get op fahn dehn grayv. Dehn di dischrai di fayt a sohn peepl weh mi bileev.

Bot notn noh wahn shayk di schrang fongdayshan stoan weh Gaad don mek. Ahn di werd dehn weh mi rait pahn da fongdayshan stoan seh, “Di Laad noa dehn wan weh bilangz tu hihn,” ahn “Evribadi weh seh dehn bilangz tu di Laad hafu stap du dehn wikid ting weh noh rait.”

Now den, eena dehn big hows yu ku fain aal kaina dish ahn bowl. Sohn mek owta goal ahn silva, ahn peepl yooz dehndeh fi jos speshal okayzhan. Bot sohn ada wan mek owta wud ahn klay, ahn peepl yooz dehn cheep wan evri day fi aal kaina ting.

Soh if sohnbadi stay weh fahn du dehn ting weh noh rait, dehn wahn bee laik wan a dehn fansi goal dish. Gaad wahn yooz dehn fi du speshal werk, kaa dehn gi dehn hoal laif tu di Laad, ahn dehn redi fi du aal kaina gud.
Ron fahn dehn temtayshan weh yong peepl aalwayz di get eena. Yu fi goh afta evriting weh rait, ahn goh afta fayt, lov ahn pees, lang wid aal dehn peepl weh kaal pahn di Laad wid wahn kleen haat.
Noh ga notn fi du wid dehn foolish aagyument weh peepl weh noh andastan notn get eena, bikaaz yu noa seh dat dehndeh aalwayz en op eena kwaaril.
Di wan weh di du di Laad werk noh fi kwaaril. Ih fi bee kain tu evribadi, ahn ku teech gud ahn bayr payshens wid peepl weh haad fi get lang wid.
Ih noh fi taak haad ahn rof wen ih di teech dehn wan weh noh agree wid ahn. Bikaaz maybi sohntaim Gaad wahn gi dehn di chaans fi ton fahn dehn sin dehn ahn kohn fi noa di chroot.
Den dehn wahn noa seh dat weh dehn mi du noh rait. Ahn den dehn wahn get weh fahn owta di devl chrap, bikaaz ih mi kech dehn ahn mek dehn du weh hihn waahn.

footnotes.text: grays: Gaad lov ahn kainis weh wi noh dizerv.
